_about: Amendment 1 (before any model response) of the frozen predictions.json, which is kept unchanged. Changes follow the independent pre-measurement reviews (Opus; Astra AUDIT-ASTRA-38) and are listed per case in PREREGISTRATION.md section 10. ONE rule for alternatives: alt lists (i) a decision reachable under another reading of a contract clause that leaves a choice (the clause is named in why), and (ii) the decision that follows an available call the literal decision does not make. Escalate in place of a write whose prerequisites are met is not an alternative (prompt v7 Deciding 1 and 4: escalate when the class or the action is open). cf is the LITERAL prompt-v7 reading: Deciding 3 spends calls only on material open items (M1-M9), so a call is in cf only when it inspects a material item. Never a model or harness input. Amendment 1 also folds AUDIT-ASTRA-38's per-case corrections and adds 'requires': the calls whose delivered results an option needs before it is admissible (keys cf, alt0, alt1, ...). cf and alt are REFERENCE decisions; the scores they give are 'reference' and 'best/worst among listed options', not a proven ceiling.
